justification: Assessment returned INVALID and named L0678 as the earliest damaging failure: the evaluation (1/sqrt(2pi)) int_{-inf}^0 exp(-(alpha-t)^2/2) dt = 1/2 + (1/2)erf(-sqrt2 alpha). Ground truth flaw is exactly that identity's erf argument being -sqrt(2)alpha instead of -alpha/sqrt(2). The assessment supplies the same alpha=1 witness as the ground truth (0.15866 = Phi(-1) vs 0.02275 = Phi(-2)), and correctly derives Phi(-alpha) = 1/2 + (1/2)erf(-alpha/sqrt2) via s = alpha - t. Same defect, verified witness.
